acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.p1: By accessing or using the AL Jadwal platform ("Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform. You must be at least 18 years old to register for or use the Platform; by accepting these Terms you confirm that you are 18 years of age or older and legally able to enter into a binding contract.

platform.title: 2. Platform Description
platform.p1: AL Jadwal is an online marketplace that connects customers with vendors who offer activities, experiences, tours, and events across the GCC region. AL Jadwal acts as an intermediary and does not itself provide any activities.

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
accounts.p1: You must provide accurate information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. You must not share your account with others or create multiple accounts.
accounts.p2: Phone verification is required to complete a booking. Email verification is required for email/password accounts.

accountTermination.title: 4. Account Suspension and Termination
accountTermination.p1: We may suspend or terminate your account if you breach these Terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or violate applicable laws. Where practicable, we will give you advance notice and an opportunity to address the issue before termination. In cases of suspected fraud, repeated abuse, or actions that risk other users or vendors, we may suspend access immediately without prior notice.
accountTermination.p2: You may close your own account at any time via the account settings page. After termination, your personal data is anonymised in accordance with our Privacy Policy, but records required for accounting, tax, or regulatory compliance — including booking history, payment records, and audit logs — are retained for the periods required by Qatari law. If you believe your account was terminated in error, you may appeal by contacting our support team at the address listed in the Contact section.

bookings.title: 5. Bookings & Payments
bookings.p1: All bookings are subject to availability and vendor confirmation. Prices displayed include the activity fee and a platform service fee. Payment is processed securely through our payment gateway — AL Jadwal never stores your card details.
bookings.p2: Upon successful payment, you will receive a booking confirmation with a reference number, activity details, and location information.

cancellation.title: 6. Cancellation & Refunds
cancellation.p1: Cancellation policies are set by individual vendors and displayed on each activity page. If you cancel a confirmed booking, the applicable refund amount depends on the vendor's cancellation policy.
cancellation.p2: AL Jadwal reserves the right to cancel bookings in cases of fraud, vendor unavailability, or force majeure events. In such cases, a full refund will be processed. These cancellation and refund practices operate in compliance with the Qatar Consumer Protection Law (Law No. 8 of 2008), which sets minimum protections for consumers in commercial transactions.

forceMajeure.title: 7. Force Majeure
forceMajeure.p1: Neither AL Jadwal nor vendors shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing their obligations under these Terms when such failure or delay arises from circumstances beyond their reasonable control — including but not limited to acts of God, natural disasters, severe weather, war, terrorism, civil unrest, governmental action or restrictions, pandemics or public-health emergencies, strikes or labour disputes, network or utility failures, or any other event of force majeure. In such circumstances, affected bookings may be cancelled or rescheduled and any payments made will be refunded in accordance with the cancellation policy in effect at the time.

vendorResp.title: 8. Vendor Responsibilities
vendorResp.p1: Vendors are responsible for the accuracy of their activity listings, pricing, availability, and the quality of service delivered. AL Jadwal moderates listings but does not guarantee vendor performance.

vendorCommercial.title: 9. Vendor Commercial Terms
vendorCommercial.p1: Vendors who list activities on AL Jadwal agree to a platform commission on each completed booking. The applicable commission rate and any additional fees are disclosed in the vendor onboarding agreement and displayed in the vendor dashboard. AL Jadwal may adjust commission rates with prior notice communicated through the vendor portal.
vendorCommercial.p2: Payouts to vendors are processed on a regular schedule (typically weekly), subject to a minimum payout threshold and verified bank details. AL Jadwal may withhold payouts in cases of pending disputes, suspected fraud, regulatory inquiries, or where required by court order. Bank-detail changes are subject to a security cool-down period before the next payout request can be approved.
vendorCommercial.p3: AL Jadwal may suspend or terminate a vendor account for violations of these Terms, repeated customer complaints, regulatory non-compliance, or actions that damage the platform's reputation. Suspended vendors may appeal via the support channel. Earnings on completed bookings remain due to the vendor (subject to clawback for fraud or chargebacks), and pending bookings will be cancelled and refunded to customers in line with the cancellation policy.

prohibited.title: 10. Prohibited Conduct
prohibited.p1: You agree not to: use the Platform for fraudulent purposes, attempt to circumvent payment systems, harass other users or vendors, upload malicious content, or violate any applicable laws.

ip.title: 11. Intellectual Property
ip.p1: All content on the Platform (logos, design, text, software) is owned by AL Jadwal or its licensors. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without written permission.

liability.title: 12. Limitation of Liability
liability.p1: AL Jadwal is not liable for any direct, indirect, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Platform or from any activity booked through the Platform. Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the specific booking in question.

law.title: 13. Governing Law
law.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Qatar, including (without limitation) the Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law (Law No. 13 of 2016) and the Qatar Consumer Protection Law (Law No. 8 of 2008). Any disputes arising out of or in connection with these Terms shall be resolved exclusively in the competent courts of Doha, Qatar.

loyalty.title: 14. Wanasa Loyalty Points
loyalty.p1: Customers earn Wanasa loyalty points on completed bookings according to the rate published in the Loyalty section of the Platform. Points have no cash value, are non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for currency outside of the Platform's redemption flow.
loyalty.p2: AL Jadwal reserves the right to adjust the earning rate, redemption rate, minimum redemption threshold, and expiry policy at any time, with reasonable notice posted on the Platform. Points obtained through fraud, refunded bookings, or violation of these Terms may be revoked without notice.

changes.title: 15. Changes to Terms
changes.p1: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms. We will notify registered users of significant changes via email.

contact.title: 16. Contact
contact.p1: For questions about these Terms, contact AL Jadwal at Management@jadwal.qa or by mail at Apt 18, Floor 1, Building 60, Street 840, Zone 39, Doha, Qatar.

account.label: Account Information:
account.text: Name, email address, phone number, and profile photo (if using Google Sign-In).

booking.label: Booking Information:
booking.text: Activity details, dates, guest counts, and payment references.

device.label: Device Information:
device.text: Browser type, operating system, and approximate location (country-level via IP, used for showing relevant activities).

session.label: Session & Security Data:
session.text: IP address, user-agent, and login timestamps for each active session. Stored to secure your account, detect unauthorized access, and let you revoke suspicious sessions. Retained only while the session is active plus a 90-day security-log window.

vendor.label: Vendor Information:
vendor.text: Business name, description, bank details (for payouts), and activity listings.

loyalty.label: Loyalty (Wanasa) Points:
loyalty.text: Points earned from completed bookings, the redemption history, and the timestamp of each ledger entry. Points have no monetary value and cannot be transferred or exchanged for cash.

push.label: Push Notifications:
push.text: If you enable browser notifications, we store the push subscription endpoint your browser provides (via Apple, Google, or Mozilla push services) so we can deliver booking and account alerts. We use a VAPID keypair to authenticate our service to the push provider — the keypair identifies us, not you.

use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
items: Process bookings and payments
Send booking confirmations and important updates
Verify your identity (email and phone verification)
Show relevant activities based on your country
Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized account access
Improve the Platform and the quality of our service
Communicate with you about your account

payment.title: 3. Payment Data
payment.p1: AL Jadwal does not store credit card numbers, CVVs, or bank card details. All payment processing is handled by our PCI-compliant payment gateway (PAY2M). We only store payment references and transaction status for your booking history.

sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing

vendors.label: With Vendors:
vendors.text: Your name, email address, phone number, and booking details are shared with the vendor providing the activity (including when you request a refund).

gateway.label: Payment Providers:
gateway.text: Transaction data is shared with our payment gateway for processing.

processors.label: Service Providers (Sub-processors):
processors.text: We rely on vetted third parties that process data on our behalf under data-processing agreements, each receiving only what its function requires: Amazon Web Services (hosting, database, and backups — Frankfurt, Germany), Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, and edge security — global), Resend (transactional email delivery), PAY2M (payment processing — Qatar), Google (Sign-In / OAuth for users who choose it, plus Google Ads and Google Analytics 4 for advertising measurement and site analytics), Meta (the Facebook Pixel, for advertising measurement), and Microsoft (Clarity, for anonymised session replays and heatmaps). The advertising and analytics providers receive data only from visitors who have not declined cookies.

legal.label: Legal Requirements:
legal.text: We may disclose data when required by law or to protect our rights.

sharing.neverSell: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures including:
items: HTTPS encryption for all data in transit
Secure, HttpOnly cookies for authentication tokens
Bcrypt hashing for passwords (we never store plaintext passwords)
Rate limiting and account lockout to prevent brute-force attacks
Regular security audits of our codebase
PII masking in free-text logs (emails and phone numbers are never logged in full)
IP address and session metadata stored in dedicated security tables only — never scattered across free-text logs
security.breach: In the event of a personal-data breach that is likely to affect your rights, we will notify the affected users and the competent Qatar authority without undue delay after becoming aware of it, in line with the Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law (Law No. 13 of 2016). The notice will describe the nature of the breach, the data involved, and the measures taken to address it and limit its effects.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.p1: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. Booking history is retained for accounting and legal compliance. Security logs (including IP addresses and login metadata) are retained for 90 days. You can request deletion of your account and personal data at any time.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.p1: We use essential cookies for authentication (login sessions) and localStorage for UI preferences (theme, language). We also use analytics and marketing cookies — the Meta (Facebook) Pixel, Google Ads and Google Analytics 4, and Microsoft Clarity — to measure our advertising and understand how visitors use the site. Microsoft Clarity additionally records session replays (mouse movement, clicks and scrolling) to show us where pages are confusing; it is never enabled on checkout, payment, account or sign-in pages, and page text and anything you type are masked in those recordings. You can decline all of these at any time via the cookie banner; declining does not affect core functionality.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights
rights.intro: Under the Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law (Law No. 13 of 2016) — the PDPPL — you have the right to:
items: Access your personal data
Correct inaccurate data
Delete your account and associated data
Export your booking history
Withdraw consent for optional data processing
Object to processing of your personal data based on our legitimate interests (PDPPL Article 5)
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at the address below. We respond within the timeframes required by the PDPPL.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.p1: AL Jadwal is not intended for users under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we discover that we have collected data from a child, we will delete it promptly.

intlTransfer.title: 10. International Data Transfers
intlTransfer.p1: AL Jadwal is a Qatar-based platform, but for technical reasons our infrastructure runs on cloud providers outside Qatar. Specifically: (a) our database, application servers, and backups are hosted in Amazon Web Services Frankfurt (Germany) region; (b) our content delivery network and DNS are operated by Cloudflare globally; (c) push notifications are routed through Apple, Google, or Mozilla push services depending on your browser; (d) transactional and account emails are delivered through Resend; (e) if you sign in with Google, Google processes your authentication data. By using the Platform, you acknowledge that your personal data is transferred and processed outside of Qatar. We rely on contractual safeguards (AWS Data Processing Addendum, Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum) to maintain confidentiality and integrity in transit and at rest. We process your personal data in compliance with the Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law (Law No. 13 of 2016) ('PDPPL'), and we apply the appropriate safeguards required by Article 8 of the PDPPL when transferring personal data outside the State of Qatar.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify registered users of material changes via email. Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.p1: For privacy-related inquiries, contact AL Jadwal's Data Protection team at Management@jadwal.qa or by mail at Apt 18, Floor 1, Building 60, Street 840, Zone 39, Doha, Qatar.
